5
Wiase adefoɔ ho kɔkɔbɔ
1 # Luk 6.24 Na afei, mo adefoɔ e, mo amanehunu a ɛreba mo soɔ nti, monsu na mommɔ bena! 2#Mat 6.19 Mo ahonyadeɛ aporɔ, na nweweboaa awe mo ntadeɛ. 3Mo sika ne dwetɛ awe nnaakyen, na ɛho nnaakyen no bɛdi mo adanseɛ, na ɛbɛdi mo nam sɛ ogya. Moahyehyɛ agyapadeɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire mu. 4#Deut 24.14-15 Hwɛ, adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔtutuu mo mfuo mu nnuane no akatua a mode nsisie de sieeɛ no team, na wɔn a wɔatwitwa mo mfuo mu adeɛ no nteamu aduru asafo Awurade no aso mu. 5#Luk 16.19; 16.25; Yer 12.3 Mode asetena fɛfɛ atena asase so, na moabɔ ahohwie, na moayɛne mo akoma sɛ okum da. 6Moabu deɛ ɔtene no fɔ akum no; ɔnsi mo kwan.
Abodwokyɛre wɔ amanehunu mu
7 # Luk 21.19; Heb 10.36 Enti, anuanom, monya abodwokyɛre nkɔduru da a Awurade bɛba. Hwɛ, okuafoɔ a ɔretwɛn asase aba a ne boɔ yɛ den no to ne bo ase kyɛre wɔ ho, de kɔsi sɛ ɛnya feefee ne asusɔ. 8Mo nso, monya abodwokyɛre, monhyɛ mo akoma den, ɛfiri sɛ da a Awurade bɛba no abɛn. 9Anuanom, monngugu ahome nntiatia mo ho, na wɔammu mo atɛn. Hwɛ, ɔtemmufoɔ no gyina ɛpono ano. 10#Mat 5.12 Anuanom, momfa adiyifoɔ a wɔkasaa Awurade din mu no nyɛ amanehunu ne abodwokyɛre nhwɛsoɔ. 11#Hiob 1.21-22 Hwɛ, yɛbu wɔn a wɔhunuu amane, too wɔn bo ase wɔ mu no ahotɔfoɔ. Moate Hiob amanehunu mu boasetɔ no, na moahunu sɛdeɛ Awurade maa no wiee no, sɛdeɛ Awurade ayamyɛ dɔɔso, na ɔyɛ timmɔborɔ.
12 # Mat 5.34-37 Na me nuanom, yeinom nyinaa akyiri no, monnka ntam! Monnka ɔsoro anaa asase anaa ntam biara. Na momma mo aane nyɛ aane, na mo dabi nyɛ dabi, na moanhwe atemmuo mu.
Gyidie mpaebɔ
13 # Dwom 50.15; Kol 3.16 Mo mu bi hunu amane anaa? Ma no mmɔ mpaeɛ. Obi bo atɔ ne yam anaa? Ma no nto ayeyie nnwom. 14#Mar 6.13 Mo mu bi yare anaa? Ma no mfrɛ asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ, na wɔmmɛbɔ ne so mpaeɛ, na wɔnsra no ngo Awurade din mu. 15#Mar 16.18 Na gyidie mpaebɔ bɛgye ɔyarefoɔ no nkwa, na Awurade bɛma no so, na sɛ wayɛ bɔne bi a, wɔde bɛkyɛ no.
16Monkeka mo mfomsoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho mo ho, na momommɔ mpaeɛ mmema mo ho mo ho, na wɔasa mo yadeɛ. Onipa tenenee adesrɛ a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ nnoɔma bebree. 17#1 Ah 17.1; Luk 4.25 Elia yɛ onipa te sɛ yɛn ara, na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ denden sɛ osuo nntɔ. Na osuo antɔ asase so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abosome nsia. 18#1 Ah 18.42 Na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ bio, na osuo tɔɔeɛ, na asase soo n’aba.
19 # Gal 6.1 Me nuanom, sɛ mo mu bi fom firi nokorɛ ho na obi dane no a, 20#Dwom 51.13; Mmb 10.12; 1 Pe 4.8 ma no nhunu sɛ, deɛ ɔdane ɔdebɔneyɛni firi ne mfomsoɔ kwan soɔ no, bɛgye ne kra afiri owuo mu, na wakata bɔne pii so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na afei, mo adefoɔ e, mo amanehunu a ɛreba mo soɔ nti, monsu na mommɔ bena! Mo ahonyadeɛ aporɔ, na nweweboaa awe mo ntadeɛ. Mo sika ne dwetɛ awe nnaakyen, na ɛho nnaakyen no bɛdi mo adanseɛ, na ɛbɛdi mo nam sɛ ogya. Moahyehyɛ agyapadeɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire mu. Hwɛ, adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔtutuu mo mfuo mu nnuane no akatua a mode nsisie de sieeɛ no team, na wɔn a wɔatwitwa mo mfuo mu adeɛ no nteamu aduru asafo Awurade no aso mu. Mode asetena fɛfɛ atena asase so, na moabɔ ahohwie, na moayɛne mo akoma sɛ okum da. Moabu deɛ ɔtene no fɔ akum no; ɔnsi mo kwan.

Enti, anuanom, monya abodwokyɛre nkɔduru da a Awurade bɛba. Hwɛ, okuafoɔ a ɔretwɛn asase aba a ne boɔ yɛ den no to ne bo ase kyɛre wɔ ho, de kɔsi sɛ ɛnya feefee ne asusɔ. Mo nso, monya abodwokyɛre, monhyɛ mo akoma den, ɛfiri sɛ da a Awurade bɛba no abɛn. Anuanom, monngugu ahome nntiatia mo ho, na wɔammu mo atɛn. Hwɛ, ɔtemmufoɔ no gyina ɛpono ano. Anuanom, momfa adiyifoɔ a wɔkasaa Awurade din mu no nyɛ amanehunu ne abodwokyɛre nhwɛsoɔ. Hwɛ, yɛbu wɔn a wɔhunuu amane, too wɔn bo ase wɔ mu no ahotɔfoɔ. Moate Hiob amanehunu mu boasetɔ no, na moahunu sɛdeɛ Awurade maa no wiee no, sɛdeɛ Awurade ayamyɛ dɔɔso, na ɔyɛ timmɔborɔ.
Na me nuanom, yeinom nyinaa akyiri no, monnka ntam! Monnka ɔsoro anaa asase anaa ntam biara. Na momma mo aane nyɛ aane, na mo dabi nyɛ dabi, na moanhwe atemmuo mu.

Mo mu bi hunu amane anaa? Ma no mmɔ mpaeɛ. Obi bo atɔ ne yam anaa? Ma no nto ayeyie nnwom. Mo mu bi yare anaa? Ma no mfrɛ asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ, na wɔmmɛbɔ ne so mpaeɛ, na wɔnsra no ngo Awurade din mu. Na gyidie mpaebɔ bɛgye ɔyarefoɔ no nkwa, na Awurade bɛma no so, na sɛ wayɛ bɔne bi a, wɔde bɛkyɛ no.
Monkeka mo mfomsoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho mo ho, na momommɔ mpaeɛ mmema mo ho mo ho, na wɔasa mo yadeɛ. Onipa tenenee adesrɛ a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ nnoɔma bebree. Elia yɛ onipa te sɛ yɛn ara, na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ denden sɛ osuo nntɔ. Na osuo antɔ asase so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abosome nsia. Na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ bio, na osuo tɔɔeɛ, na asase soo n’aba.
Me nuanom, sɛ mo mu bi fom firi nokorɛ ho na obi dane no a, ma no nhunu sɛ, deɛ ɔdane ɔdebɔneyɛni firi ne mfomsoɔ kwan soɔ no, bɛgye ne kra afiri owuo mu, na wakata bɔne pii so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
